title: Payment Risk Review
description: Select general security review, Payment Risk Review or both in Assessment options. Both reviews share one source snapshot and a findings list. The payment profile produces eight report sections, recorded outcomes for six payment scenarios, calculated risk scores and proposed regression tests. Source-backed issues remain Needs review until independently verified; this beta profile does not execute live penetration tests.
upgrade: Recreate the API, worker and web services together. When using the optional local Strix controller, restart it with the updated source-review tools before selecting Payment Risk Review. No database migration or new setting is required for this profile.
